data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

words.word: I’m very appreciative of your help.
I’m appreciative for your help.
Appreciative means jealous.
She feels confident about the exam.
She feels confidence about the exam.
Confident means nervous.
He became covetous of his friend’s success.
He became covetous to his friend.
Covetous means thankful.
She felt envious of her colleague’s promotion.
She felt envious to her colleague.
Envious means calm.
He felt humiliated after the mistake.
He felt humiliated of the mistake.
Humiliated means excited.
She is interested in learning new languages.
She is interested to learn new languages.
Interested means bored.
If you need assistance, please call reception.
If you need assist, please call reception.
Assistance is a kind of recipe.
Her family gave her support during the move.
Her family supported to her during the move.
Support is a type of passport.
The lake was calm and tranquil.
The lake was tranquilised.
Tranquil means tense.
Practice helped her build confidence.
Practice helped her build confident.
Confidence means fear.
